# Stockfish 19 source code

Check & Conquer bundles the unmodified Stockfish 19 executable as a separate
UCI process. Stockfish is licensed under GNU GPL version 3; the license text is
included as `COPYING.txt` in this directory.

The complete, corresponding source for Stockfish 19 is available without
charge from the official immutable release tag:

https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish/tree/sf_19

The official release and platform downloads are available at:

https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish/releases/tag/sf_19

Check & Conquer does not modify Stockfish. The Linux release is compiled by
our GitHub Actions workflow from that Stockfish 19 source; the Windows release
uses the unmodified official Stockfish 19 universal executable.
